_about: Hand-kept WoW Forever instance table (launched 4 Nov 2026). levels = [recommended low, high]. tier: 0 dungeon, 1 first raid tier (opens 9 Dec 2026). ids.warcraftdb_zone_id = overworld zone (forever.warcraftdb.com /api/data/node/zone/{id}) containing the entrance; warcraftdb has no instance zone ids (dungeon NPCs carry no zone, quests carry zone name only) so ids.warcraftdb_zone_name is the quest 'zone' string. See reports/hand-tables.md.
